content.text:
Yes — both [Info.plist](ios/beacon/Info.plist) and [strings.xml](android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml) are XML files, and `&` is a reserved character in XML that must be escaped as `&`. Using a bare `&` would make the file invalid XML.

[app.json](app.json) is JSON, so `&` is used there directly — which is what I did.
